- Daily exercise calories varied widely (320–1,180 kcal), with high day-to-day variability.
- Weekly averages: Week 1 (Mar 9–15) 824 kcal, Week 2 (Mar 16–22) 850 kcal, Week 3 (Mar 23–29) 759 kcal, revealing a slight initial increase followed by a notable decline of about 91 kcal in Week 3.

- Peak days exceeding 1,100 kcal occurred once each week (Mar 13, Mar 22, Mar 24, Mar 29) but did not offset the overall decreasing trend in weekly totals.

- Weekly averages remained stable: Week 1 439.3 min, Week 2 428.6 min, Week 3 437.1 min, showing no meaningful upward or downward trend.
- Occasional longer sleeps occurred on weekends (e.g., March 21: 510 min, March 28: 495 min), but the pattern was inconsistent.
- Over the three weeks, sleep duration stayed relatively stable with no clear change.
